quotes.text: We visited twice last year and took a boat out for a full day both occasions if I recall correctly. We had a wonderful time. The staff was amazingly informative and helpful. They made sure we were prepared to have someone who was boat approved. ( I believe the captain in your group has to have some kind of boating license, they'll tell you about it if you're unaware/unsure) and they put all our belongings for the trip onto the boat for us, and helped us unload at the end of each day. They gave us good laughs, and good memories. Thanks for being great!

Excellent service and reasonable price. Neal was the cheerful, friendly gentleman who took care of us, first on the phone answering questions for me, then in person when we came to rent 2 paddle-boards on a very busy Saturday. In all the busy-ness he remained friendly, calm and cool. The staff assisting with the rentals was also very helpful, personable and knowledgeable even though they were very busy. Overall excellent experience, we are eager to rent from them again soon. Highly recommended to all locals and visitors.

Extremely professional and knowledgeable staff, very courteous and friendly. Chris was very reassuring and answered any question we had. Absolutely loved the boating experience and all the helpful tips for what we were trying to do and see. We were a family of 6 adults and 5 kids, we rented one of the pontoons and fit comfortably. Definitely looking forward to renting from them again and recommend them highly. Thanks for the experience!!

The guys at Island Marina Rentals could not have been any better. They set us us with GPS routes and where to go and what to do. We ran out of drinks so we called and they told us where to go. We saw dolphins and manatees. Had a ball and such a good time that we decided that we're coming back again to rent a boat again. These guys had the best attitude possible. If I could give 10 stars I would. Keep it up guys.

Really nice people and fair prices. We rented a paddle board for two hours. They offered us a cart to wheel it over for free. Even though we returned it 35 minutes late, we weren't charged any extra. The rental process was very easy as well! We were in and out in five minutes! I would definitely rent from this group if we were here again.

My husband, our 11yo daughter, and I came in towards the end of the day. Everyone was so friendly, happy to see us and eager to get us out on the water. Very knowledgeable and incredibly reasonable. We are locals and it was our first experience kayaking the intercoastal. We loved it!! We will be back! Thanks for the great hospitality!
